summary: Resolute Holdings Management, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a credit facility amendment (Second Amendment) adding $60M in term loans and reallocating $40M revolver under its existing Credit Agreement. The filing also includes a press release announcing Q1 2026 financial results (Item 2.02). No transaction that qualifies as a special situation: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, tender offer, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The amendment is an ordinary credit facility modification. Thus classified as 'None'.
